title: Oldest agreed domestic dog
summary: Dog remains buried with people at Oberkassel are the oldest widely agreed domestic dog. Earlier dates around 23,000 years ago in Siberia are proposed.
why: Probably the first domesticated animal, long before any crop.

notes.problem: 'The first domesticated animal' stated as fact; summary itself notes earlier proposed dates.

superlativeSource: The oldest agreed domestic dog remains belongs to the Bonn
